title: Batch 148 — eight in-place enrichments of original Hebrew Sichos; duplicate AID 2989555 merged into its canonical Evidence Family; no new source identities
metrics_note: The failed CI reconciliation run 44167373651 measured 1496 / 854 / 3815 in its workspace before batch148. That snapshot counted AID 2989555 twice under two Evidence Family IDs (batch101 and batch141). This batch merges the duplicate into the pre-existing canonical family (-1 family) and adds eight inspected propositions to existing identities (+8 propositions). Expected boundary 1495 / 854 / 3823 is a calculation, not a measured post-batch result; reconciliation is pending.

canonical_identity_collisions.resolution: duplicate removed; propositions merged into canonical record

deduplication_check.note: The current large public-search-index could not be read through the connector. A file-level scan of 89 content-research batches (055–147), 12 bulk-indexed files and 40 mixed-authorized-content files found one collision: AID 2989555 in batch101 and batch141. It was resolved in this commit. The review queue had no matches for the eight enriched AIDs. Full canonical reconciliation remains pending.

retrieval_synthesis.root_cause: AID 2989555 existed in batch101 and was duplicated in batch141 with a different Evidence Family ID. The search index deduplicates by AID and retained the earlier canonical batch101 record, which lacked the later dissemination propositions. The duplicate was removed and its two inspected propositions merged into the batch101 identity; a further proposition was added from body lines 190–193.
retrieval_synthesis.engine_change: No answer-engine logic change was required: the existing wellsprings branch already selects up to eight source candidates. The regression was caused by the duplicate canonical identity and family split.

note: שמונה זהויות עבריות קיימות הועשרו בפרפרזה מחקרית אחת כל אחת. לא נוספו זהויות מקור חדשות ולא קודם מקור ל-Verified. נמצאה ותוקנה כפילות AID 2989555 בין batch101 ל-batch141; שתי הפרפרזות מהעותק הכפול מוזגו בזהות הקנונית, ומשפחת הראיות אוחדה. חמש הפניות חלופיות החזירו 429; לא בוצע crawler retry ולא נעקפו בקרות.
